create_HabitatLogger_instance: create a HabitatLogger instance with a custom name, log level, and optional filename for file-based logging
create_HabitatLogger_with_stream: create a HabitatLogger instance that writes to a stream instead of a file using the stream parameter
add_filehandler_to_logger: add an additional file handler to an existing HabitatLogger instance to log to multiple files
use_module_logger: use the pre-configured habitat module-level logger to log messages with timestamp formatting
configure_logger_via_env: configure the habitat logger level by setting the HABITAT_LAB_LOG environment variable before importing
